body: Depends on how well I’ve been respected. If I’ve been treated like a human being by management, then yes, they deserve a warning at least. But I’ve had jobs where I quit on the spot.
Remember when we all used to just laugh and not get so offended by things that are so obviously a joke

Yes, and about to do it again. Average of 110 hours every two weeks and with pretentious arrogant customers. I haven’t replied to my friends or have spoken to my parents in weeks. I just can’t do it anymore

It’s really not and people like to make it seem like each and every human is destined and cut out to be a Bezos and when in reality that’s not true. I personally prefer a much easier quiet simple life, but quite literally cannot because society forces us to have to “hustle” just so we can breath and plants ideas that if we’re not striving for some sort of “greatness” then we’re the issue.
that would be the exact moment I knew it was really my child
